A LITTLE ABOUT ME

I’m Ayobami.
I bring structure,
rhythm and character
to the page.

I design brochures, catalogs, magazines and business reports in Adobe InDesign. My work centres on thoughtful typography, purposeful image placement and a clear reading experience.

Each publication gets its own visual language—from a bold culture magazine to a quietly refined product catalog.

Adobe InDesign / Print & digital layouts

FROM CONTENT TO PUBLICATION

A clear process, from the first brief.

01 / BRIEF

Set the direction

We review your content, audience, brand assets, page count and intended format.

02 / LAYOUT

Build the visual language

Typography, image treatment and page structure establish the direction for the publication.

03 / REVIEW

Refine the details

Consolidated feedback helps refine the layout, content flow and consistency across pages.

04 / HANDOVER

Prepare the agreed files

The final handover follows the formats and specifications agreed for your project.

BEFORE WE START

A few practical questions

What should I send for a quote?

Your approximate page count, final or draft content, brand assets, reference designs, deadline and intended use: print, digital or both.

Can you work with an existing publication?

Yes. Share the existing document and explain whether you need a redesign, updated content or a layout that follows the current style.

Can the final document be editable?

Editable InDesign files can be included when agreed in the project scope. PDF exports and any required linked assets can be discussed as part of the handover.

Do you also write the content?

The service focuses on publication design. Please supply the text, product information and data you want included, and confirm whether any additional content work is needed.

Can I see a complete publication?

Every project here includes its full page collection, an interactive reader and a downloadable PDF viewing copy.
